verdict.rationale: Morph is an inference API and toolset (Fast Apply, WarpGrep, Compact, Reflexes, MCP server) that powers external agents such as Claude Code, Codex, and goose. Nothing in the evidence documents a built-in AI assistant inside Morph's own product that users can hand tasks to. Serving models and tools to third-party agents is a developer building block, not an in-product assistant, so it earns no credit.
